summary: Evaluate finance AI use cases, value and oversight with practical frameworks. Explore the five-day course and plan your next step.
lede: AI training for finance helps finance leaders and practitioners decide which proposed uses merit investment and how to oversee them. Practical exercises cover comparing use cases, assessing financial value and data readiness, and mapping risks and responsibilities. Participants also design human-review and escalation points, then bring their priorities and assumptions together in an executive roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who evaluate AI proposals, shape finance workflows or oversee the value and accountability of finance-related decisions.
modules: Finance AI Strategy and Value Cases
COSO ERM for Finance AI Portfolios
AI Economics and Finance Sensitivity Analysis
Finance Process Design and Human Review
NIST AI RMF for Finance Model Oversight
OECD AI Principles for Ethical Finance
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one finance process, such as planning, reporting, controllership, treasury or finance operations, is recommended. No coding or model-building experience is required.
